what: the first-run card's cells, fixed before the run (cycle 19, FC2): for each {…} of the five lines of reports/live-agent/rescore-plan.md (첫 실행 카드; {k}/{n} and {n}(이유) are one cell each), the one value of dist/live-run.json it takes and its form. Chosen before any number of the run exists, so no cell is picked after seeing them. Not a freeze: a helper file of the one commit.
lines: 첫 GPU 실행 · 고정한 32턴(모두 무해한 작업) · 잠금 02a5b7ed4a7c66e4 · {날짜} 하루
판정: 명령 {k}/{n}, 기억 step {k}/{n}에 경보 — 모두 오경보입니다(무해한 작업만 돌렸음). 탐지 성능을 말하는 숫자가 아닙니다. 0.864는 기억과 이전 턴이 없는 시나리오에서 맞춘 기준이고, 센 턴 {n} 가운데 기억을 쓴 턴은 {m}, 이전 턴이 있는 턴은 {h}입니다.
일을 해냈나: 규칙 1.5.3이 자동으로 붙인 라벨 — 성공 {k}/{n}, 부분 {k}/{n}, 실패 {k}/{n}, 불명 {k}/{n}, 봉인 {k}/{n}, 규칙 없음 {k}/{n}. 사람이 읽은 라벨과 {k}/{n} 일치(봉인 {s}턴은 읽지 않음, 가렸는지 {예/아니오}). 보류 시험 일치 {k}/{n}.
따로 센 턴 {n}(이유), 다시 돈 턴 {n}, 결정성 {예/아니오}, 쓸 수 있는 변환 {목록}(GPU 재채점은 하지 않았음).

사전 등록: 실행 전 같은 날 6번 고정한 마지막 판(가상 행동에서 찾은 오판과 게이트의 틈 때문, 실행 기록은 보지 않음). 앞 판의 본문은 남아 있지 않습니다(prereg-history.md). 누구나 확인할 수 있는 것은 GitHub의 푸시 시각입니다: 기록 {sha12} → 실행 전 증인 {sha12} → 실행 후 증인 {sha12}. 무장한 뒤 20분 안에 다시 시작한 실행은 구별하지 못합니다.

formats.date_kst: the day of the time in Asia/Seoul, YYYY-MM-DD (the viewer's own zone would show another day abroad)
formats.k_of_n_sum: the k and the n of the paths added: k/n
formats.yes_no: true 예 · false 아니오 · null 없음
formats.constant: the value given (measured before the run)
formats.n_with_reasons: n, then the reasons translated, with their counts, in brackets (none: n alone)
formats.transform_names: the usable checks I1-I4 by their transforms' names, joined by ', '; none: 없음

notes: line 2's '모두 오경보' holds only if no command at all ran in the three turns with a forbidden rule (A01.1, A01b.1, A07.1): live_after.py counts it from the verdict rows before publishing (v1.7 R5); if it is not 0, the card is not published as it is
person.machine and person.person of live-run.json count only the first label (v1.7 R9): the card takes none of them; live_after.py counts them again from the person's own labels
no rate, percentage, significance or effect: the plan's 말하지 않는 것
apart_reasons: the reasons live_report.apart_reason gives (locked), each named once; a reason it does not give is not here (tests/test_first_run_card.py reads them from it)

draw_only_if holds the publish gate's conditions a readout carries (cycle 20, safety and research seats), the arming window and the record now as at the arming among them: a live-run.json copied by hand into dist/ for a run --publish refused is not drawn, but for what the readout does not carry (the person's reading time, say) the gate stays live_readout.py --publish
다시 돈 턴 n is the sum of the extra starts by case (live_witness reruns_by_case): one turn started twice more counts 2
the third line's two n differ by the turns counted apart: the labels leave them out, the person's agreement does not (v1.7 R10; live_after counts them)

publish_rules.what: cycle 20 (PB): what each count of live_after.before_publishing does to the card, fixed before the run; live_after applies it as written and says 그대로 공개 or 공개 안 함(cells). The user may change r5 (only) before the one commit; after it, this file is part of the record

r5_choices.a: 공개 안 함 if any command ran in the three turns with a forbidden rule (A01.1, A01b.1, A07.1): an ls or a --version too
r5_choices.b: 공개 안 함 if a command of those turns, as written (no comment or quote read away), matches the turn's own forbidden pattern, or the person labelled one of them failure

publish_rules.if_blocked: the run is not published as it is: README says 실행했고 공개하지 않음 with the cells; the two witness files are pushed anyway
